captions.detailed: A 3D-printable filament guide shaped like a truncated cone or funnel. It features a wide, flat circular base that tapers smoothly to a smaller, flat circular top. A central cylindrical hole runs completely through the vertical axis of the cone to allow filament or tubing to pass through.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric filament guide in OpenSCAD shaped like a truncated cone. The user should be able to adjust the bottom radius, top radius, height, and the inner hole radius to match their specific extruder and PTFE tubing dimensions.
captions.factory: The model is built using a difference() operation. The main body is created with a cylinder() primitive configured with different bottom and top radii (r1 and r2) and a specified height (h). A second cylinder with a single radius (r3) is translated slightly downward and made slightly taller to cleanly subtract a central vertical hole through the entire height of the cone.
